title: VCPS work item (FEATURE, REVIEW, BUG, RELEASE, TINY, HOTFIX, AUDIT)
description: Structural schema shared by .vcps/features/FEAT-*.md, .vcps/reviews/REV-*.md, .vcps/bugs/BUG-*.md, .vcps/releases/REL-*.md, and .vcps/work-items/WORK-*.md (TINY/HOTFIX/AUDIT), per templates/contract.md: 'One work-item schema covers FEATURE, REVIEW, BUG, RELEASE, TINY, HOTFIX, AUDIT.' NEW_CANONICAL_RECONSTRUCTION authored 2026-10-06; see evaluation/completion-roadmap.md Phase B.

id.description: FEAT- for FEATURE, REV- for REVIEW, BUG- for BUG, REL- for RELEASE, WORK- for TINY/HOTFIX/AUDIT (templates/contract.md ID prefix list).

component_ref.description: Component identifier from risk-model.md, or null for project-wide scope.

level.description: The component/project level reference at the time this work item was classified.

risk_class.description: Required for a change-making intent (FEATURE/BUG/TINY/HOTFIX). Null is valid for REVIEW (until it proposes a change) and AUDIT (always read-only, VCPS-WF and templates/validation.md item 8: 'AUDIT cannot claim implementation gate outcomes'). RELEASE records the highest class among its included changes.

lifecycle_state.description: Required, and only meaningful, when intent is FEATURE (lifecycle.md SS1). Other intents use workflow_state instead.

workflow_state.description: Required when intent is not FEATURE. FEATURE uses lifecycle_state instead, which carries the Core-defined state machine; this is a simpler generic progress marker for the other six intents, which have no equivalently detailed Core-owned state machine of their own.

state.description: templates/contract.md: a derived projection. PENDING until decision_ref exists, then equal to that decision.

criteria.description: Required (non-empty) when intent is FEATURE (lifecycle.md ACCEPTED transition: an E4 acceptance record references each criterion).

success_signals.description: FEATURE only: observable signals of PRODUCTION_PROVEN success.

observation_window.description: FEATURE only: the window (e.g. days, or a free-text description) over which success_signals are observed before PRODUCTION_PROVEN. standard/open-questions.md OQ-008 leaves any default window undefined; this field carries a per-feature value, not a project default.

defect_ref.description: Required when intent is BUG: the finding record for the defect this work item fixes.

intent_sources.description: Required (non-empty) when intent is REVIEW: what REVIEW reconstructed intended behavior from (design docs, prior features, specifications).

included_changes.description: Required when intent is RELEASE: the work-item/feature IDs included in this release unit.

release_revision.description: Required when intent is RELEASE: the exact revision being released.

gate6_ref.description: Required KEY (present) when intent is RELEASE, but the VALUE is null until Gate 6 has actually been evaluated (gates/README.md VCPS-GATE-021) -- a RELEASE record legitimately exists and is BLOCKED before that happens; this field MUST NOT be fabricated to point at a Gate 6 PASS the release has not received.
